mapper.select: SELECT id, id_plane, id_airport_dep, id_airport_arr, code, datetime_dep, datetime_arr, region_dep, region_arr, distance, seat_first_class, seat_business_class, seat_economy_class, price, cancellation_fee, gate, status, create_at FROM flight WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flight (id_plane, id_airport_dep, id_airport_arr, code, datetime_dep, datetime_arr, region_dep, region_arr, distance, seat_first_class, seat_business_class, seat_economy_class, price, cancellation_fee, gate, status) VALUES (#{idPlane}, #{idAirportDep}, #{idAirportArr}, #{code}, #{datetimeDep}, #{datetimeArr}, #{regionDep}, #{regionArr}, #{distance}, #{seatFirstClass}, #{seatBusinessClass}, #{seatEconomyClass}, #{price}, #{cancellationFee}, #{gate}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE flight SET id_plane = #{idPlane}, id_airport_dep = #{idAirportDep}, id_airport_arr = #{idAirportArr}, code = #{code}, datetime_dep = #{datetimeDep}, datetime_arr = #{datetimeArr}, region_dep = #{regionDep}, region_arr = #{regionArr}, distance = #{distance}, seat_first_class = #{seatFirstClass}, seat_business_class = #{seatBusinessClass}, seat_economy_class = #{seatEconomyClass}, price = #{price}, cancellation_fee = #{cancellationFee}, gate = #{gate}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
